newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Smith Barney Q1 oper net up.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Smith Barney Q1 oper net up.

text.p: Travelers Group said its Smith Barney unit had first quarter operating earnings of $238.9 million, up from $223.9 million a year ago.
Smith Barney's revenues rose three percent, to $1.66 billion.
Travelers's consumer finance unit has first quarter operating earnings of $47.3 million, down from $55.9 million a year earlier.
The life and annuity business reported operating earnings of $101.1 million versus $82.6 million. The Primerica unit had operating earnings of $78.1 million versus $65.3 million.
